AuthorValue: The one post-gap commit on 2025-07-23 ('update package, clean readme, fix urls, fix Rd links submit to CRAN') is a CRAN compliance release, not renewed development.
The only post-gap commit (2025-05-02 'Update README.md') is a documentation touch-up, likely pointing readers elsewhere; no code changes.

New volunteers resumed submissions: PR #1088 (Jun 2019, Florian Cabot) and a burst of PRs #1089-#1094 (Nov 2019, Christian Sturm / Sol-d adding missing NGTS, KELT, WASP, HATS planets). From 2023 the recovery is sustained by 'Automated nightly update from oec_continuity' commits, i.e. the maintainer automated the data feed.

A user problem (issue #24, Aug 2020, template copy failing) prompted David Laehnemann to remove the oversized .test/report.html (PR #25) and fix a biomart caching failure (PR #26, Sep 2020); regular maintenance continued, reaching a bot-tagged v4.0.0 release in Oct 2025.

Recent commits add OpenSSL/TLS build support and merge the v2.18.1 changes.

AuthorValue: Oct 2016 commits add a citation to the APS DPP 2016 presentation and update project status; the first real code lands in Feb 2017 ('Very basic Plasma object', Drew Leonard) and activity grows to 5,367 commits in 2022.

The refactor was merged (Feb 2019), a controlled-gate bug was fixed (Jul 2019), and a 'Major feature updates' commit introduced a CMake 3.15 build system (Dec 2019), leading to the 2020 burst of 299 commits.
